steps.name: Hierda
steps.text: You asked me why the first 'language' I shared with you after our thoughts resonated was 'death'...

steps.name: Hierda
steps.text: I really don't know either.
Aboard this strange, colossal vessel called 'Rhodes Island,' the Cautus can barely feel the passage of time.
It makes her uneasy. Ever since the day she became Infected, time has meant everything to her.
Time will bring her death—and perhaps, liberation.
However, the beings who dwell in this strange place—yet deny they are gods—seem utterly indifferent to it.

steps.name: Hierda
steps.text: Maybe it's because I've never been afraid of dying. Death is nothing more than a passage to a new environment.

steps.name: Raydistorter
steps.text: (Rim Billitonian) Pessimist.

steps.name: Raydistorter
steps.text: That's how they would describe you in your own language, yes?

steps.name: Hierda
steps.text: A pessimist? I don't think so.

The Cautus blurts it out, and regrets it—just a little. She had agreed with many of the clergy's arguments back during those debates… but now that she's here, does she still need to think in those terms?
Does she really care about everything she experienced before the collapse?
After all, even time has forsaken her now.

steps.name: Hierda
steps.text: I once worked in a mine that seemed to be endless. To maintain efficiency, the overseer would kill or drive off any bothersome Originium slugs.

steps.name: Raydistorter
steps.text: Originium slugs? A mine?

steps.name: Hierda
steps.text: Yes. Those Originium slugs are even weaker than me, and the mines... the mines were once my home.

steps.name: Hierda
steps.text: But the overseer didn't expect that the kindest worker in the mine was secretly feeding and caring for the Originium slugs they were trying to drive away—which only drew more of them into the mine.

steps.name: Hierda
steps.text: Eventually, the slugs disrupted the mine's foundation, leading to a collapse.

steps.name: Raydistorter
steps.text: But you survived?

steps.name: Hierda
steps.text: The slugs' secretions fed me.

steps.name: Hierda
steps.text: In such a harsh environment, many of them lived short lives, yet new ones kept being born. They gave me strength—

steps.name: Raydistorter
steps.text: Miners, Originium slugs, and yourself—but your story ignores the 'death of Terra,' Hierda.

steps.name: Raydistorter
steps.text: You do not treasure your 'Terra'.

steps.name: Hierda
steps.text: That's not true at all! In our language, 'Terra Bless Us' is a phrase that invokes something almost divine—

steps.name: Raydistorter
steps.text: Hmm... you still have a very limited definition of 'life'.

steps.name: Hierda
steps.text: I don't understand. You've shown me so many individuals, each starkly distinct from the next… You all feel love and hate just as we do—and yet, are still vastly different from each other.

steps.name: Hierda
steps.text: 'Salvaging death from the grave'—you all live united by a purpose that I can't understand.
But why have I come here?
The Cautus ponders this question, but her intuition tells her the answer lies with the person who just extended a hand to her.

She looks out the porthole at the top of the cabin into the cold, silent, endless expanse of space. The light from the distant, giant sphere once again passes over the dead planet, piercing the Cautus's eyes.
However, despite her blurry vision, she spots a small silhouette within the light.

steps.name: Hierda
steps.text: There is... someone out there, in deep space?

steps.name: Hierda
steps.text: Is that the one I'm looking for?
Someone out in the depths of space seems to hear the Cautus's voice—a shadow within the light stirs ever so slightly.

steps.name: Voice From Within
steps.text: (Unknown language) You're looking for me?
One circle, two circles, the little dots are spinning in the darkness.
They're accelerating, coming closer and closer.
They rip a hole in the darkness, and a bright, blazing beam of light shines through.
I extend my arms and embrace them.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Core body temperature is elevated; nerve blocker has already been administered.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Body temperature rising rapidly. Prepare to administer muscle relaxant and replenish blood volume.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Repeat the medication again, and let's start the operation—

steps.name: Chloe
steps.text: Dr. Warfarin?

steps.name: Chloe
steps.text: Did I doze off again? Maybe I'm just really exhausted.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Don't try and speak now. Your throat is badly injured.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: You feel like you went to sleep?

steps.name: Chloe
steps.text: Yes, and I had a long dream.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: You didn't feel any other discomfort?

steps.name: Chloe
steps.text: Erm... no. Did something happen just now, Dr. Warfarin?

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Nothing major. Did you dream about anything... special?

steps.name: Chloe
steps.text: Anything special? That's hard to say.

steps.name: Chloe
steps.text: In my dreams there were balls of mud spinning around each other on black velvet...

steps.name: Chloe
steps.text: They are now big, now small. One moment they were smaller than children's marbles, the next larger than the whole of Victoria.

steps.name: Chloe
steps.text: Someone picked them up and flung them back out. They started smashing into each other and bursting like fireworks, but the whole time, I didn't hear a sound.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Anything else...?

steps.name: Chloe
steps.text: I also saw threads—stretching from one ball of mud to another, each one made of light. And on every thread, there were people—running outward, racing along the light.

steps.name: Chloe
steps.text: I followed them. I ran to a white patch of earth. It was completely empty...

steps.name: Chloe
steps.text: Save for a single stone tablet standing there.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Stone tablet? What was written on it?

steps.name: Chloe
steps.text: Nothing, Dr. Warfarin, and that's when I woke up.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: What a strange dream, but then again, you remember it quite clearly, which means your brain's memory module is still functioning properly.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: The more clearly you remember your dream, the closer you were to waking up when you dreamed it. As I see it, the fact that you were able to remember your dream is a very good thing.

steps.name: Chloe
steps.text: Say, I haven't seen Dr. Touch today...

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: She has other matters to attend to. She told me to give this to you. Look.

steps.name: Chloe
steps.text: Huh? The spring, the gears... the hands... all the parts that make up a clock!

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: She said it would help relieve your stress.

steps.name: Chloe
steps.text: Dr. Warfarin, is Rhodes Island in some kind of trouble again?
Little one, you've come to the wrong place.

steps.name: 'Beepy'
steps.text: (Unsurprisingly, Beepy got lost.)

steps.name: 'Beepy'
steps.text: (Hiding in fear)

steps.name: Sarkaz Boiler Worker
steps.text: It seems like Closure failed to examine your program modules.

steps.name: Sarkaz Boiler Worker
steps.text: Little one, this item here should definitely not be on your maintenance list.
The Goliath lifts it gently and examines it curiously in his hands.

steps.name: 'Beepy'
steps.text: (Angrily spins treads)

steps.name: Sarkaz Boiler Worker
steps.text: What a huge change. It was empty when Her Highness left.

steps.name: Sarkaz Boiler Worker
steps.text: Now, there are so many interesting people and things here, right?

steps.name: Sarkaz Boiler Worker
steps.text: Ascalon.

steps.name: Sarkaz Boiler Worker
steps.text: Tell them not to worry. I'll take care of the mobility layer.

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: Okay.

steps.name: Sarkaz Boiler Worker
steps.text: Ascalon, you seem in poorer spirits than you were when you returned from Victoria.

steps.name: Sarkaz Boiler Worker
steps.text: What about all the people working under you?

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: They have been dispatched to create the Isolation Zone outside the ship. I'm remaining on this ship, and that's sufficient.

steps.name: Sarkaz Boiler Worker
steps.text: Rhodes Island does indeed need a blade that moves through the darkness, but that doesn't mean that you need to consciously remain silent.

steps.name: Sarkaz Boiler Worker
steps.text: Come chat with me when you have time. I have liquor here.

steps.name: Sarkaz Boiler Worker
steps.text: Besides, I want you to tell me about Theresis.

steps.name: Sarkaz Boiler Worker
steps.text: I witnessed the beginning of that heroic epic, and you witnessed its end. What we saw was very different.

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: Okay.

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: I will convey your thoughts to the Doctor and Amiya when they have time.
The Goliath places 'Beepy' in front of the exit passage.

steps.name: Sarkaz Boiler Worker
steps.text: Stop wandering around—the mobility layer is dangerous. Don't underestimate what high-concentrations of Originium can do to someone like you.

steps.name: Sarkaz Boiler Worker
steps.text: I'll keep my eye on the work here, and that'll be enough.

steps.name: 'Beepy'
steps.text: (Runs away in a panic)

steps.name: Sarkaz Boiler Worker
steps.text: Dame Kal'tsit, what could've gotten you this tense?

a.text: PRTS Operation Record: [Confidential] Escort Catastrophe warning system and medical center core components

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Situation abnormal. Enemy weapons technology exceeds mission parameters. Risk of exposure present.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Possible enemy signal detection capability. Shutting down drone transmission temporarily.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Logos, I'm counting on you for the drone's live feed.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: I'm ready.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: 'Circuits.' Etched into Originium through spoken words—drawn by hand to reveal what the swarm perceives.
Logos's bone pen hovers in the air, automatically transcribing the images recorded by the drone.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Twelve flexible vehicles buried in the sand. Thirty-one armed militants.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: The five sniper's nests have already been marked. There seems to be a signal isolation device in the tent, which the scanner cannot penetrate.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: All are carrying unidentified weapons. Threat level unknown. Further on-site confirmation required—

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Raidian, you're up next. I'm starting the drone recall procedure.

steps.name: Communicator
steps.text: In position!

steps.name: Communicator
steps.text: Wait a second. Can you see me?
The bone pen taps lightly—its strokes weaving together the rough outline of a human form.
Raidian gives a tentative wave to the two people watching the feed, and even in floating text, her smile comes through clearly.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: We are standing by, ready to assist you.

steps.name: Communicator
steps.text: It's no problem. In ninety seconds, your drone and I will leave together.
On screen, Raidian walks into the signal-blocking tent as if no one else is there—and the transmission cuts out.

steps.name: Communicator
steps.text: Bzzzz—

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Logos?

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: We're ready to launch a full assault at any time—the incantations have already drifted on the wind to the edge of their camp.

steps.name: Communicator
steps.text: Bzzzt—Done! All intel's been transcribed. I'll be back in a sec!

steps.name: Communicator
steps.text: It didn't create even a single stir—I overwrote the visual signals received by each target's brain.

steps.name: Communicator
steps.text: Chances are, all they saw was a mischievous little sandbeast slipping into the tent to escape the wind and sand.

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: Mechanist, how goes it? Did you discover anything while parsing the intel reports?

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: All weapons have had their origins erased and have been modified to suit their operators.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: But I'm familiar with how to operate it. Doctor discussed its rather rare design with me just recently.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: They are from Ægir.

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: Ægir? But the people who are going to interface with us, aren't they also...?

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: Regardless, the threat has been cleared.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: We must not yield to such a threat and allow it to interfere with our equipment transfer—nor can we create any disruption that could alert the personnel involved.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: The matter is of great importance and needs to be resolved quietly.

a.text: PRTS Operation Record: [Confidential] Ensure the transfer and installation of mining modules

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard
steps.text: There is no way. They're wearing special protective equipment to ward off our physical attacks.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Sniper
steps.text: This was arranged in advance—they even knew our personnel layout.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard
steps.text: Orchid, stay back, they're clearly after our mining module.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Figures. I knew I'd end up working overtime again.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Spot, support Midnight and Catapult.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Popukar, have you called for reinforcements?

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Yeah... I called already.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Orchid, be careful!

steps.name: Attacker
steps.text: Hmm... futile. As for the others...

steps.name: Attacker
steps.text: Where is that sound coming from?!

steps.name: Pith
steps.text: You really have prepared well. Unfortunately, you're not quite strong enough to handle Arts.

steps.name: Attacker
steps.text: No, that's not right. It shouldn't be you.

a.text: 'Shh. Even your heart has gone silent.'

steps.name: Touch
steps.text: I'll deal with the injured. That said, Midnight is getting too worked up again.

steps.name: Touch
steps.text: Orchid, I'll have to trouble you to deal with him.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Leave him to me.

steps.name: Pith
steps.text: The Doctor guessed correctly. Someone leaked the details of our operations.

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: Wrap this up quickly. Tow the backup mining ship to the nearest nomadic city and get the energy bay patched up.

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: Then return to the ship at once to avoid any mishaps.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: P-Pith, why are you our backup?

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: PRTS told me it would be Misery...

steps.name: Pith
steps.text: You followed a hunch?

steps.name: Pith
steps.text: A last-minute change in plans right before departure; I'm just worried that...

options: Misery, Stormeye, Sharp and such have other plans.

steps.name: Pith
steps.text: Do we need to inform the rest of our colleagues via PRTS?

options: If everything goes well, I was worrying over nothing.
If anything goes wrong, resolve the issue as quickly as possible and then return to defend the ship.

a.text: PRTS Operation Record: [Confidential] Escort Logistics and Engineering Department members to Kazdel

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: How many waves of mercenaries have attacked us already today?

steps.name: Stormeye
steps.text: This is the seventh wave now.

steps.name: Stormeye
steps.text: They may not be too threatening, but it's really strange how many of them have been attacking us every day this past week.

steps.name: Stormeye
steps.text: We've only just crossed Kazdel's border.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: These guys do not fear death. They remind me of the mercenaries we met in Sargon.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: Faithless.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: Misery, what's taking you so long? We planned for you to be back by now.

steps.name: Misery
steps.text: You should know that this place is still quite some distance from the Scar Market.

steps.name: Misery
steps.text: Even if I knew every shortcut around here, it would still take me some time.

steps.name: Stormeye
steps.text: What has the investigation revealed so far?

steps.name: Misery
steps.text: For the past two weeks, someone's been routing the majority of Scar Market's orders here, through a network of outsourcers.

steps.name: Misery
steps.text: There's no way to trace the client—they've covered their tracks well.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: In other words, it was just 'bad luck' that we ran into these mercs?

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: They're not actively coming to attack us?

steps.name: Stormeye
steps.text: I'm afraid so.

steps.name: Stormeye
steps.text: It seems that not all of the worries Doctor had before we departed were unfounded.

steps.name: Fang
steps.text: Everyone, there's news from the sentries.

steps.name: Fang
steps.text: Another group of mercenaries is shifting toward our position. There's a high chance we'll be engaging them again soon.

steps.name: Misery
steps.text: (Sighs)

steps.name: Fang
steps.text: Misery, something's not right here.

steps.name: Fang
steps.text: These unending waves of mercenaries don't seem to be trying to harm us. Instead... it's like they're...

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: Trying to delay us.

steps.name: Fang
steps.text: We can stay here and continue escorting the team. You all can return to the ship now.

steps.name: Misery
steps.text: Don't worry, Fang.

steps.name: Misery
steps.text: Some folks are going to find it harder than they thought to put their schemes into motion.
The air is fluctuating.

steps.name: Fang
steps.text: Is that wind?

steps.name: Fang
steps.text: No, is that... the Lifebone?!
High above the sky, a massive skeleton has emerged, stirring the dust of history and casting a vast shadow below.
For many at Rhodes Island, it is their first time seeing the massive skeleton that once appeared during the chaos in Victoria.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Engineering Operator
steps.text: What a sight...

steps.name: Misery
steps.text: While investigating the Scar Market, I took a trip to Kazdel to meet a few old friends.

steps.name: Misery
steps.text: Let's leave the rest to them.

steps.name: Misery
steps.text: We should go home.

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: I've already silenced all communications in visible range. Engaging now.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: (Blows bone whistle)

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Hmph. Their weapons counter my gear, but they offer little resistance against your bone whistle and incantations.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: Far from it. They just don't quite understand the rules of my speech yet.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: I'm curious about the thought process the Ægirs followed in developing such precise weaponry.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Then I'll grab a few pieces to take back and dismantle—I'll help you study them.

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: Come on you two! We are carrying out a mission here!

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: There are at least three squads waiting in ambush up ahead. We can't take them all on.

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: I'm afraid we can't handle this cleanly and quietly anymore—we'll need to tell our people to brace for the assault.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Hey! Hey! Hey! The reinforcements the Doctor called for are here!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Raidian, Mechanist, mark the location for us. The Bad Guy will be there soon!

spans.text: Raidian, Mechanist, mark the location for us. The

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Blaze?!

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Check your communication devices. I synchronized our location with you.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Acknowledged.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Wait a moment, Rosmontis, didn't we agree I'd rush in first and draw their fire away from you?

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: I'll control the Arts.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Finished?

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: I checked the signals in the surrounding area. They've all been cleared out.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Uhh... who can tell me what this thing really is?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: When it tried to self-destruct, I had to use all of my strength just to stop it.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: The people interfacing with us are also Ægirs. Why are they attacking our people and equipment?

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Let Dr. Kal'tsit and the Doctor determine that.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Ensure that we return to the ship as soon as our personnel and equipment are safely transferred to Clementia.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: We need to deal with these issues as soon as possible.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: There are still other unknown leakers out there. This is just the beginning, I'm afraid.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: That's strange, why is PRTS responding even slower now? Or is it just my imagination?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: This isn't right, no. Let me check it again.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: PRTS, output all back-end logs from the past two weeks.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Uhuh. No problems here....and no problems here either...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: No problems anywhere?
